hic.39: Sources conflict: the 2021 Exam Guide p3 says apply in person by appointment at 42 Broadway or the Jamaica SBS center, or online; the 9/2026 checklist says in-person appointments only in hardship cases.
hic.57: Sources conflict: the Exam Guide p3 and Admin Code 20-112 say notify at least 10 days BEFORE an address or trade-name change; 6 RCNY 1-08 says notify within 10 days OF the change.
hic.111: Sources conflict: the 2021 Exam Guide pp3/8 says the prime contractor must secure all permits; the 6/2026 inspection checklist and model contract say the appropriate party may be the HIC or another licensed professional (Local Law 181 of 2025).

ps.29: May be outdated: the $700-$1,000 penalty comes only from the Admin Code text dated 3/3/2025. Local Law 183 of 2025 (effective 9/8/2026) reformed process server licensing, and its full text could not be fetched (legistar blocked).
ps.37: Sources conflict: 6 RCNY 1-08 says within 10 days of a change of address; Admin Code 20-112 says at least ten days before it.
ps.42: Sources conflict: Admin Code 20-406.3(a) says records shall be retained in electronic form; 6 RCNY 2-233 and GBL 89-cc also allow bound paginated volumes.
